translator.name: bod kyi lo tsA ba khyung grags
slob dpon chen po phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes pa Dom+bi he ru ka

item.tib: mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa
item.coloph: mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa/ slob dpon chen po phyag rgya chen po dngos grub bsnyes pa Dom+b+hi he ru ka'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /sa pho spre'u dpyid zla tha chung yar gyi ngo chos bco lnga la/ gza' mig dmar gyi nyin par dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag dpal/ lha btsan po khri dbang phyug rin po che don tham cad sgrub pa'i bka' lung gis/ rgyal mo sum bu za lun gyis 'do zer gyi sku gnyer mdzad nas/ bkra shis kyis gdan sa chen po btsong kha ser to bla mkhar gyi nang du bod kyi lo tsA ba khyung grags kyis 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o
